verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Chargebee offers hosted pages for customer-facing billing interactions and PCI-compliant checkout, which implies self-service capability, but no evidence explicitly describes a self-service portal for upgrade/downgrade/cancel flows or embeddable components. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of self-service plan change/cancel via hosted portal, embeddable components, and independent/hands-on confirmation that customers can complete these actions without support intervention.
